components.name: Type styles
anatomy: Apply one type class to a semantic heading or text element.
Keep the HTML heading level independent from the visual class.
accessibility: Preserve a logical heading outline; visual size does not determine heading rank.

components.name: Editorial primitives
anatomy: Use inside prose with a 60–65ch measure.
Figure captions belong inside figure.
modifiers: .eyebrow-serif is the editorial counterpart to product-oriented .eyebrow.
states: Figures and pull quotes avoid breaks in print.
accessibility: Use blockquote for quotations and meaningful alt text for figure images.
components.markup: Quiet interfaces leave room for the work.

components.name: Button
anatomy: .btn supplies structure; add one intent modifier.
Use a native button for actions and an anchor for navigation.
modifiers: Primary, secondary, ghost, danger, and small.
accessibility: Pair aria-busy=true with disabled while an action is pending.
Icon-only buttons need an accessible name.
components.javascript: Only the product action; Inkwell supplies state styling.
components.markup: <button class="btn btn-primary" type="button">Save changes</button>

components.name: Text controls
anatomy: Place a labelled control inside .field.
Use .textarea for multi-line input and .select on native select.
accessibility: Every control needs a label and name.
Invalid controls set aria-invalid=true and reference error copy with aria-describedby.

components.name: Field group
anatomy: Label, control, then helper or error text.
.field-row aligns related controls without removing labels.
modifiers: Helper and error copy are mutually contextual, not visual replacements for labels.
accessibility: Connect help or error IDs from the control with aria-describedby.
components.markup: Use letters, numbers, and hyphens.

components.name: Choice controls
anatomy: Wrap a native input and visible text in the matching label class.
modifiers: Checkbox for independent choices, radio for one-of-many, switch for immediate settings.
states: Checked, unchecked, focus-visible, and disabled native states.
accessibility: Radio groups need a fieldset and legend.
Do not use a switch for a submit-time preference.
components.javascript: None for native state; application behavior may respond to change.
components.markup: <label class="checkbox"><input type="checkbox" name="updates"> Product updates</label>

components.name: Segmented control
anatomy: A .segmented group containing two to four buttons or .seg items.
modifiers: Mark the selected option with aria-pressed=true or .is-active.
accessibility: Give the group an accessible label and expose selection with aria-pressed.
components.javascript: Application code updates the selected choice.

components.name: Badge
anatomy: Short, non-interactive status text inside .badge.
modifiers: Neutral, accent, success, warning, and danger.
accessibility: Do not rely on hue alone; the label must name the status.
components.markup: Published

components.name: Issue pill
anatomy: Compact severity or resolution label.
modifiers: .sev for severity and .resolved for completed findings.
accessibility: Include meaningful status text; color is supplemental.
components.markup: Resolved

components.name: Card
anatomy: Paper surface containing an optional title and body.
modifiers: .is-link adds a restrained hover affordance to a genuinely linked card.
accessibility: If the whole card navigates, use one clear anchor rather than nested interactive elements.

components.name: Card grid
anatomy: Responsive parent for sibling cards.
modifiers: Override the minimum column size only when content requires it.
accessibility: DOM order remains reading order; do not rearrange items visually.

components.name: Avatar
anatomy: Image or initials inside .avatar; groups overlap siblings.
modifiers: No public size modifiers; override dimensions locally only when the surrounding pattern requires it.
accessibility: Use meaningful alt text when the identity is not repeated nearby; otherwise use empty alt.

anatomy: A visible dot plus a textual status label.
accessibility: Keep the text label; the dot is intentionally not the sole signal.

accessibility: Use an ordered list when sequence matters and machine-readable time elements for dates.

states: Print swaps the fill for an ink border.

components.name: Section heading
anatomy: Optional index, semantic h1 or h2, and optional count.
modifiers: Use the index only when sequence carries meaning.
accessibility: Use the correct semantic heading rank; the class styles h1 and h2 equally.

accessibility: Set aria-label=Breadcrumb on nav and aria-current=page on the last item.

components.name: Tabs
anatomy: A labelled tablist of tabs plus one labelled panel per tab.
Each tab's aria-controls points to its panel; each panel's aria-labelledby points back.
states: Selected, hover, focus-visible, and hidden panels.
accessibility: Use roving tabindex and ArrowLeft/ArrowRight/Home/End navigation.
Do not use tabs when users need to compare panels simultaneously.
components.javascript: Load inkwell-interactions.js or reproduce the documented WAI-ARIA behavior.

components.name: Alert
anatomy: Optional title followed by concise guidance.
states: Persistent notice or dynamically announced alert.
accessibility: Use role=alert only for important content inserted after load; static notices need no live role.
components.javascript: None unless the product inserts or dismisses the alert.

components.name: Callout
anatomy: Label and emphasized editorial statement inside a ruled panel.
accessibility: Use an aside when the callout is complementary; do not use visual treatment as heading semantics.

components.name: Code block
anatomy: Optional label and pre/code pair inside a framed block.
states: Scrolls internally when code is wider than its container.
accessibility: Keep commands as selectable text and identify the language in nearby copy when relevant.
components.javascript: None; copy buttons are an application enhancement.

components.name: Dialog
anatomy: Native dialog with head, labelled title, body, and action footer.
A trigger's data-dialog-open value matches the dialog ID.
states: Closed, modal open, cancel, and return-focus.
accessibility: Use native dialog.showModal(), aria-labelledby, an obvious close action, and restore focus to the trigger.
components.javascript: inkwell-interactions.js wires data-dialog-open and data-dialog-close; native Escape handles cancel.

components.name: Skeleton
anatomy: Decorative blocks that approximate pending content.
states: Animated normally, static under reduced motion and print.
accessibility: Hide decorative skeletons from assistive tech and mark the containing region aria-busy=true.
components.javascript: Application code removes the skeleton and clears aria-busy when content arrives.

components.name: Table
anatomy: Semantic table wrapped in .tbl-scroll when columns may exceed the viewport.
states: Container-level horizontal scroll on narrow screens.
accessibility: Provide a caption, use th with scope, and keep page-level scrolling vertical.
